newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt refers 23 alleged militants to court.
newsitem.headline: Egypt refers 23 alleged militants to court.

text.p: Egyptian prosecutors have agreed to send to court 23 suspected Islamic militants accused of planning violent attacks, security sources said.

The suspects, alleged leaders of the militant Gama'a al-Islamia (the Islamic Group) and its military wing, are accused of organising attacks targeting police, tourists, journalists, artists and ministers, they said late on Thursday.
Authorities seized weapons and money belonging to the group, all of whom were said to have returned from Sudan and received military training abroad.
An alleged fugitive group leader, Mustafa Hamza, is among the accused.
There was no date for the court hearing or arrests.
Gama'a has been fighting the government since 1992 to establish a strict Islamic state. More than 1,000 people have been killed in the conflict.
